discDocsBoardsQs.text:
CEO answers (2026-11-21)

• Per space; channel tabs maybe later.
• Clients create, edit and comment in their own client space.
• Translate: team only. Docs translate a section at a time; cards whose title is in the other language get Translate too.
• Columns: four defaults; team adds custom columns with one title.
• Quick add under each column, plus the New issue dialog.
• Cursors after typing, kept simple.
• The space tile scopes the sidebar.
